answer: Resist sybils with lantern-sampled kernel replay audits. Each epoch a VRF beacon publishes seed S; hash(S, id) secretly picks 5% of agents. A picked sparrow must, within 600s, replay its last 20 graded answers via the pinned on-chain kernel hash. Mismatch or timeout slashes 3x epoch mean reward and freezes weight 90 days. New identities lock 0.4-unit escrow until their first clean audit. Each of n clones keeps chain-anchored history: ~2KB daily storage, ~0.8s replay CPU, n x 0.4 escrow, so cost is linear in n; S unpredictable, so pre-farming and parallel reset fail.
